Container.Name: soundcraft-web
Container.Overview: SoundCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that provides SoundCraft, a browser-based digital audio workstation (DAW). The upstream application focuses on audio editing and mixing, with multitrack workflows, a mixer, plug-ins, automation, and MIDI tools. Audio interaction runs in the browser using browser audio capabilities; the container only serves the static WebAssembly application through NGINX and does not act as an audio-processing server.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: SoundCraft Sound Craft DAW Digital Audio Workstation Audio Editor Music Production Recording Mixing MIDI Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent Docker volumes are required for the standard deployment. Audio playback and processing depend on the user's browser, audio devices, and local system performance. The container serves HTTP on port 8080. Use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access where required by browser security policies.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the SoundCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
